props.name: axis
props.description: Lock drag to a single axis. `'both'` allows free 2D pan.

props.name: bounds
props.description: Bounds in px relative to the drag origin. Omitted side = unbounded.

props.name: duration
props.description: Reset animation duration in ms. Only used when `resetOnEnd` is `true`.

props.name: emitMove
props.description: Emit `drag-move` on every touchmove. Off by default.

props.name: momentum
props.description:
Carry release velocity into a momentum coast: a flick keeps gliding and
decelerates to rest (clamped to `bounds`) instead of stopping dead at the
finger. Ignored when `resetOnEnd` is `true` (reset wins). Off by default.

props.name: momentumDecel
props.description:
Deceleration rate for `momentum`. Higher = shorter fling. Projected
coast distance is `velocity / decel`.
